## Project Overview

This project collects movie ratings, genres, and box office earnings using the OMDb API. Our goal is to study which movie characteristics are associated with higher box office earnings.

## Data Collection

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)

omdb_api_key <- readLines("omdb_api_key.txt")

movies <- c(
  "Coco", "Titanic", "Avatar", "Barbie",
  "Oppenheimer", "Inception", "Interstellar",
  "Frozen", "Jaws", "Shrek", "Whiplash",
  "Parasite"
)

get_movie_data <- function(movies) {
  omdb <- tibble(
    Title = character(),
    Year = double(),
    Genre = character(),
    Metascore = double(),
    imdbRating = double(),
    BoxOffice = double()
  )

  for (i in 1:length(movies)) {
    url <- str_c(
      "https://www.omdbapi.com/?t=",
      movies[i],
      "&apikey=",
      omdb_api_key
    )

    Sys.sleep(0.5)
    onemovie <- GET(url)
    details <- content(onemovie, "parse")

    omdb[i, 1] <- details$Title
    omdb[i, 2] <- parse_number(details$Year)
    omdb[i, 3] <- details$Genre
    omdb[i, 4] <- parse_number(details$Metascore)
    omdb[i, 5] <- parse_number(details$imdbRating)
    omdb[i, 6] <- parse_number(details$BoxOffice)
  }

  omdb
}

omdb <- get_movie_data(movies)
omdb
```

## Export Cleaned Data

```{r}
write_csv(omdb, "movies_clean.csv")
```

## Variable Descriptions

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| Title | Movie title |
| Year | Release year |
| Genre | Movie genre or genres |
| Metascore | Metacritic score from 0 to 100 |
| imdbRating | IMDb audience rating from 0 to 10 |
| BoxOffice | Reported domestic box office earnings in US dollars |

## Data Limitations

The dataset contains 12 selected movies, not a random sample. It can be used for exploratory comparisons, but the results cannot be generalized to all movies.
